exposure: hospital characteristics (mixed hospital, location in noncapital city, fewer than 1500 deliveries per year)
obstetric history (no previous vaginal delivery, macrosomia)
cohort: 2295 women eligible for trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) delivery
finding: The elective repeat cesarean delivery rate in Brazil was high even in a low-risk group, indicating that nonclinical factors may be driving the decision for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The elective repeat cesarean delivery rate was high, even in a low-risk group.
